_comment: Fatigue (0..100, hidden, only sleep lowers it) and the farmer's tired states. Numbers are ours; see WORKLOG 2026-10-31 Fatigue.

work._comment: Extra fatigue per tool swing: in rain or a storm, from late_from_hour to midnight, after midnight; a swing without enough stamina still happens and every missing stamina point becomes overwork fatigue.

awake_late._comment: Fatigue when the clock reaches this hour and the farmer is still up.

sleep._comment: Fatigue lost in bed: base + per_hour for every hour from bedtime to 6:00, so going to bed early rests more.

oversleep._comment: Waking later: the latest of the fatigue rule (fatigue at bedtime at least this much) and the bedtime rule (bed at this hour after midnight).

states._comment: Tired from fatigue >= fatigue or stamina <= stamina_pct % of max; the worst state that applies wins.

pass_out._comment: Still up at 2:00: carried home, wakes late and stiff.
pass_out.message: You fell asleep outside and woke up at home...

collapse._comment: Fatigue reached 100: a neighbour carries the farmer home and calls the doctor; half the morning is lost.
collapse.message: You collapsed! A neighbour carried you home. The doctor's visit cost %d G.
